As per the Karnataka Minor Mineral Concession Rules, 1994, the minor minerals used in works shall be compulsorily procured only from authorized minor mineral quarry contractors who have obtained permission from the Department of Mines and Geology, and the minerals shall be used only after obtaining a mineral transport permit. All departments/agencies executing works shall mandatorily comply with this.

The use of minor minerals transported from unauthorized sources and used in works is illegal. If minor minerals produced from unauthorized sources are used in works without a mineral transport permit, the work contractors bills shall not be settled. Only in cases where the contractor executing the work pays to the Department of Mines and Geology a penalty equal to five times the royalty for the minor minerals used in the work, an additional payment AP of 40% of the royalty, and 10% of the royalty towards the District Mineral Foundation Fund, and submits the relevant information, action shall be taken to settle the work bills

itemList.description: Patching of Potholes - Patching of Shallow Potholes using SDBC Gr II 25 mm thick - Patching  of  shallow  potholes  on  asphalt  surfaces  by  using Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete 25mm thickness. The Cost is inclusive of removing the failed materials & cleaning on the road surface, preparation of potholes to the required standards sizes before patching them and application of tack coat at 0.20 kg/ m2 over the asphalt surface including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification.

Patching of Potholes - Patching of Deep Potholes using WBM Gr l & SDBC Gr lI 25 mm thick: Patching of Deep Potholes 75mm thick by restoring the Granular Base  course  using  material  confirming  to  WBM  Grade  -I  with 1ype  Sereenings  standards  wherever  necessary  by  manual means  including  trimming  the  pothole  to  the  required  shape and size, cleaning the pothole, applying Prime Coat (SS1) at 0.70 kg per m2 over the WBM surface and covering the surface with SDBC 25mm thick including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification.
